# fragmentFocusScript

The inline script that keeps a person's focus where it is on a page whose address names a place on it (`#reviews`). Safari jumps back to that place each time a stylesheet loads, until the person scrolls, when the page finished parsing or a link to a place on it was followed while a stylesheet was still loading: a slow connection, or a route's CSS that loads as it is used. Each jump takes focus from wherever it was: out of an open menu, or a field mid-word. The script stops both. The parser holds an inline script until the stylesheets above it have loaded, so the page finishes parsing with them in; and a link to a place on the page, clicked while a stylesheet is loading, goes there once it has loaded (two seconds at most). Put it first in `<body>`, after every stylesheet, as an inline classic script: not a module, and not `async` or `defer`. Painting waits for those stylesheets anyway, so nothing shows later. It is plain text, so a Server Component can render it. Use nothing instead on a page with no stylesheet.

```tsx
import { fragmentFocusScript } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/fragment-focus-script";
```

## Example

```tsx
<html lang="en">
  <head>{stylesheets}</head>
  <body>
    <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: fragmentFocusScript() }} />
    {children}
  </body>
</html>
```

## Returns

`string`
